questions.stem: Consider a complex reaction taking place in three steps with rate constants $k_1$, $k_2$ and $k_3$ respectively. The overall rate constant $k$ is given by the expression $k = \sqrt{\frac{k_1 k_3}{k_2}}$. If the activation energies of the three steps are 60, 30 and 10 $\mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$ respectively, then the overall energy of activation in $\mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$ is ________. (Nearest integer)
questions.solution:
$K = \sqrt{\frac{K_1 K_3}{K_2}}$
$A.e^{-E_a/RT} = \sqrt{\frac{A_1 e^{-E_{a_1}/RT} \times A_3 e^{-E_{a_3}/RT}}{A_2 e^{-E_{a_2}/RT}}}$
By comparing exponential term
$\frac{E_a}{RT} = \frac{1}{2} \times \left(\frac{E_{a_1}}{RT} + \frac{E_{a_3}}{RT} - \frac{E_{a_2}}{RT}\right)$
$E_a = (E_{a_1} + E_{a_3} - E_{a_2})/2$
$E_a = (60 + 10 - 30)/2 = 20\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$

questions.stem: The hydrocarbon (X) with molar mass 80 g $\mathrm{mol^{-1}}$ and 90% carbon has ________ degree of unsaturation.
questions.solution:
Mass of carbon $= \frac{80 \times 90}{100} = 72\,\mathrm{gm}$
Number of C-atoms $= \frac{72}{12} = 6$
Mass of hydrogen $= \frac{80 \times 10}{800} = 8\,\mathrm{gm}$
Number of H-atoms $= \frac{8}{1} = 8$
So molecular formula $\mathrm{C_6H_8}$
D.U. = 6 + 1 - 8/2 = 7 - 4 = 3

questions.stem:
In Carius method of estimation of halogen, 0.25 g of an organic compound gave 0.15 g of silver bromide (AgBr). The percentage of Bromine in the organic compound is ____________ $\times\ 10^{-1}$%. (Nearest integer)
(Given : Molar mass of Ag is 108 and Br is 80 g $\mathrm{mol^{-1}}$)
questions.solution:
% Bromine $= \frac{\text{Molar Mass of Bromine}}{\text{Molar Mass of Silver bromide}} \times \frac{\text{Weight of AgBr}}{\text{Weight of sample}} \times 100$
$= \frac{80}{188} \times \frac{0.165}{0.25} \times 100$
$= \frac{4800}{188} = 25.53 = 255 \times 10^{-1}$
